rows.note: This is the casual all-purpose choice for an ordinary small physical notebook; it can also mean an exercise book or booklet.

example.english: This notebook is for me to jot things down at work.
example.traditional: 呢本簿仔係我返工記嘢用嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 bou2 zai2 hai6 ngo5 faan1 gung1 gei3 je5 jung6 ge3

rows.note: Use this when you want to make clear that the book is specifically for taking notes, including in a more formal or digital context.

example.english: I use this notebook to record the key points of meetings.
example.traditional: 我用呢本筆記簿記低會議重點。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 ni1 bun2 bat1 gei3 bou2 gei3 dai1 wui6 ji5 cung4 dim2
